careDirection.rationale: §9 care_direction resolved to `balanced` on the `film_led_neutral` row at E2 (reference-key-2026-09-05-r4, slot 5).
evidenceSignals: §4 marker counter-signal — clause 3's leg-absence half is decided on the §3.1.1 tail marker. Marker: Phenoxyethanol, rank 6 of 25, early (§3.1.1 limit 3 strong counter-signal). Film species: Dimethicone r2, Cyclopentasiloxane r3, Dimethiconol r5. Subordinate leg species, every one of them below the marker AND below every film species: Panthenol r8 (L4), Macadamia Ternifolia Seed Oil r13 (L3), Butylene Glycol r18 (L4 on the conservative glycol reading). Hydrolyzed Quinoa r12 is a plain hydrolysate and no route at all (§7.10). No L1 cationic species exists above the marker; Quaternium-80 r14 is the only quat and is itself below it.

T19 re-derivation (2026-09-12), value CHANGED from `unknown`. Nick's ruling gives `balanced` a second, explicitly co-equal reading — directional neutrality — and reserves `unknown` for genuine evidence failure (§9; open gap §17.22 closes). All four clauses of §9's film-led rule hold on this record: (1) no R2 route present as architecture — repair_surface_film is `none_visible`, Quaternium-80 (silicone quat) sits at r14, below the r6 marker; (2) a substantive L2 film above the marker — Dimethicone r2, Cyclopentasiloxane r3, Dimethiconol r5 (architecture `emulsion`/non_lgn per §3.1.2; smoothing_route `silicone_film` per §7.4.1); (3) no L1, L3 or L4 species above the marker at all; (4) every film species outranks every candidate leg species, so the reading does not rest on the r6 marker's exact position. Confidence stays at the §9 ceiling `moderate`: this record's marker is independently verified plausible under T16 (transform-notes §18 — Dimethicone r2 and Dimethiconol r5 both sit above it), so the film-led row's one-step reduction for an implausible, vacuous or absent marker does not apply. The observation itself is unchanged — same film, same absent legs, same ranks — only the value the standard draws from it. Under AD-2 this record can now commit to the catalog; as `unknown` it could not. The pre-T19 reading is retained verbatim below.
